cards.name: Fidget Spinner
cards.caption: Spin to win (nothing)
cards.flavor: 2017: in every pocket and every classroom. Teachers still have nightmares.
cards.art: Photo of a red three-lobed fidget spinner with black bearings on a pale grey background (Wikimedia Commons, CC0).

cards.name: OK Boomer
cards.caption: OK boomer
cards.flavor: 2019's two-word comeback, dropped mid-speech in NZ Parliament. Heckle deflected.
cards.art: Parliament TV still of NZ Green MP Chlöe Swarbrick smiling at her desk mid-speech on 5 Nov 2019, the moment she answered a heckler with "OK boomer".

cards.name: Dancing Hot Dog
cards.caption: Look at him go
cards.flavor: 2017: a dancing hot dog lens crashed every selfie. Still the best dancer online.
cards.art: Screenshot of Snapchat's 3D dancing hot dog lens (green headphones, ketchup and mustard zigzags) mid-dance on a living-room floor.

cards.name: All Those Chickens
cards.caption: Look at all those chickens
cards.flavor: A Vine classic: one confident narrator, a field full of geese, and zero chickens.
cards.art: Frame from the Vine: a flock of white snow geese grazing on a suburban field in front of a big house. The girl filming is not in this frame.

cards.name: Moth Lamp
cards.caption: Brother, may I have lamp
cards.flavor: 2018: one fuzzy moth at a window started the internet's purest obsession: lamp.
cards.art: The original July 2018 Reddit photo: a fuzzy brown moth with glowing eyes and long antennae at a window at night.

cards.name: Mocking SpongeBob
cards.caption: sUrE, wHaTeVeR yOu SaY
cards.flavor: 2017: a chicken-posing SpongeBob still from 2012 became the internet's sarcasm font.
cards.art: SpongeBob hunched in his chicken pose from the 2012 episode "Little Yellow Book", cut out on white (Know Your Meme's main image).

cards.name: Mr. Skeltal
cards.caption: Doot doot
cards.flavor: Good bones and calcium will come to you: a 1999 trumpet skull, still dooting.
cards.art: The 1999 "jazzskull" GIF: a gold 3D skull blowing a brass trumpet held by bony hands, on black.

cards.name: Galaxy Brain
cards.caption: Big brain time
cards.flavor: 2017's expanding-brain chart: each idea dumber, each brain glowier.
cards.art: Last panel of the 2017 Expanding Brain template: a glowing blue-white brain in a translucent head, radiating beams of light.

cards.name: Area 51 Raid
cards.caption: They can't stop all of us
cards.flavor: 2019: two million RSVP'd to storm Area 51 arms-back. A tiny crowd actually went.
cards.art: Photo of the Area 51 main gate in Nevada two days after the 2019 raid date: a yellow barrier with stop signs across a desert road.

cards.name: Road Work Ahead
cards.caption: I sure hope it does
cards.flavor: 2016 Vine: a driver reads a road sign and delivers the decade's greatest pun.
cards.art: Photo of an orange diamond ROAD WORK AHEAD sign on a folding stand, on grass in front of a school (Wikimedia Commons).

cards.name: Dat Boi
cards.caption: Here come dat boi!
cards.flavor: 2016: a frog on a unicycle. Nobody knows why. Everybody knows the greeting.
cards.art: The Animation Factory 3D clip-art frog riding an orange unicycle on white, one arm out (frame of the classic GIF).

cards.name: Woman Yelling at a Cat
cards.caption: Smudge did nothing wrong
cards.flavor: 2019: a sobbing Real Housewife meets Smudge, a salad-hating Ottawa cat. Meme of the year.
cards.art: Smudge the white cat at a dinner table behind a plate of salad, grimacing: his owner's 2018 photo, the meme's cat panel.
